cost.basis: Driver attempt wall times once each, replaced by full child-process time when a queue receipt covers that attempt. Older cells exclude construction; missing process receipts make spend unknown. Remaining cells use whole-cell ceilings (conservative on partial cells), or the explicitly labeled scenario fallback.

inventory.backend_status: development and hash-bound sealed dispatch; final execution requires closed frozen gates

cost_ledger.basis: Process envelopes replace covered driver attempts; overlap and failures charged once each. Uncovered legacy driver times exclude process startup. JAX timers are not added.

issues: Live, interrupted or unreadable attempts have unknown costs; known spend is a lower bound and projection is unavailable.

watch.delta_scope: Global watch since the explicitly supplied previous report (or journal beginning). queue_cell_id identifies this matrix; other observations retain their original scope.
watch.delivery: not_sent; use the last actually posted report as --previous

policy.breach: strictly above either bound against either reference
policy.identity: digest of mode, recipe SHA256 and declared cell coordinates
policy.maxima: all verified observations; condition x dataset x reference x metric
policy.development_reference: first verified development observation per condition x dataset, frozen by journal order
policy.creep: a breaching entry strictly exceeds a previous maximum or twice its frozen development reference, per reference/metric
policy.reporting: immediate local alert; orchestrator conveys alerts immediately and entries at block boundaries

scientific_limit: Artifact completeness does not assert benchmark success, effect significance, admission or launch authority.
